## `lr-suggestion-chips`

Set `disabled` to disable the entire row. Re-enabling it restores the availability of each suggestion.

Customize the appearance with `--lr-suggestion-chips-gap`, `--lr-suggestion-chips-chip-bg`, `--lr-suggestion-chips-chip-color`, `--lr-suggestion-chips-chip-border-color`, `--lr-suggestion-chips-chip-radius` and `--lr-suggestion-chips-chip-padding-inline`.

Starter prompts (empty thread) and follow-up suggestions (after a response) as a horizontally
scrollable chip row; activation hands the prompt to the host, which decides whether to compose it
into an input or send it directly. Never writes into a composer or sends anything itself.
Streaming-friendly: chips render through a keyed `repeat()` on `suggestionId`, so replacing
follow-ups mid-conversation preserves focus on any chip whose identifier survives; when the focused
identifier disappears, focus repairs to the nearest surviving occurrence without overriding a newer
external focus move.

**Properties:** `suggestions: readonly LyraChatSuggestion[] = []` (attribute: false) —
`LyraChatSuggestion { suggestionId: string; label: string; icon?: string; iconName?: string; iconLibrary?: string; detail?: string; disabled?: boolean }`
(exported here). Identifiers must be nonempty and unique; invalid/later duplicates are omitted with
the first valid occurrence winning. The input is clone-owned, bounded, and frozen; reassign a new
array after changing the sequence or a row. Each chip can show one decorative icon before its
text, in increasing precedence: `icon`, an optional literal hint (for example, an emoji) rendered as
text, so SVG or other markup in it is shown verbatim and never parsed; `iconName` (with optional
`iconLibrary`, a registered `lr-icon` library; omitted uses the default set), rendered as an
`<lr-icon>`; or a light-DOM element assigned to the per-suggestion `icon-<suggestionId>` slot, such
as an inline `<svg>` or `<lr-icon>`. A slotted `<svg>` without its own `width` is sized to `1em`.
Icons are always `aria-hidden`; the chip's accessible name stays its `label`. `detail` is an
optional secondary line. `disabled` marks a suggestion non-actionable: its chip
renders a genuinely disabled `<button>` (no roving tab stop, no hover/press affordance), activating
it emits nothing, and arrow-key/Home/End roving navigation steps past it. Empty renders nothing at
all. `wrap: boolean = false`
(reflected) — wraps into multiple rows instead of a single horizontally scrollable line. `label?:
string` — accessible name for the group. Omitting it uses the localized `suggestionsLabel`; an
explicit empty string intentionally leaves the group unnamed.

**Events:** `lr-suggestion-select` — `detail: { suggestionId, label }`.

**Slots:** `icon-<suggestionId>` — decorative icon for the suggestion with that `suggestionId`
(`slot="icon-a"` for `suggestionId: 'a'`); it replaces that suggestion's `iconName`/`icon`, and the
fallback returns when the slotted element is removed.

**CSS parts:** `base` (the labeled group), `row` (the flex container holding the chips, present in
both the wrapping and the scrolling layout), `chip` (each suggestion button), `chip-icon` (the
optional decorative icon wrapper: literal `icon`, `iconName` icon or slotted icon), `chip-label` (the primary text), `chip-detail` (the secondary
line, only rendered when `detail` is set).

**Themeable custom properties:** `--lr-suggestion-chips-justify` (default `flex-start`) — main-axis
packing of the chip row. Use `center` to center the chips under centered empty-state text: it centers
every line, the wrapped final one included, which styling `::part(base)` as a centered flex container
cannot do (once the chips wrap, the row fills the available inline size and each line packs to the
start). `--lr-suggestion-chips-hover-bg` (default `var(--lr-color-brand-quiet)`) — a `chip`'s
background on hover. `--lr-suggestion-chips-hover-border-color` (default `var(--lr-color-brand)`) — a
`chip`'s border color on hover. `--lr-suggestion-chips-hover-color` (default the chip's
`--lr-suggestion-chips-chip-color`) — a `chip`'s text color on hover and press. All of these are declared as `var()` fallbacks at the point of use, not
on `:host`. `--lr-suggestion-chips-disabled-opacity` (default `var(--lr-opacity-disabled)`) — opacity of a chip whose
suggestion sets `disabled`. `--lr-suggestion-chips-label-lines` (default `1`; `3` when `wrap` is
set) — how many lines a `chip-label` shows before it is clamped with an ellipsis, so full-question
starter prompts stay readable in a narrow chat column. `--lr-suggestion-chips-chip-max-inline-size`
(default `var(--lr-size-16rem)`) — each chip's maximum inline size; in a `wrap` row it is further
clamped to the row's inline size, so a chip never overflows its container. Plus shared tokens `--lr-space-xs/-m/-2xs`,
`--lr-color-border/-surface/-text/-text-quiet`, `--lr-radius-pill`, `--lr-font-size-xs`,
`--lr-focus-ring-width/-color/-offset`.

**Optional peer deps:** none.

Keyboard: roving tabindex across chips; ArrowLeft/ArrowRight (direction-aware) plus Home/End;
Enter/Space activate. Renders inside an internal `lr-scroller` (`orientation="horizontal"`,
`without-scrollbar`) unless `wrap` is set.

```html
<lr-suggestion-chips></lr-suggestion-chips>
<lr-chat-composer></lr-chat-composer>
<script type="module">
  const chips = document.querySelector("lr-suggestion-chips");
  const composer = document.querySelector("lr-chat-composer");
  chips.suggestions = followUps;
  chips.addEventListener("lr-suggestion-select", (e) => (composer.value = e.detail.label));
</script>
```

Vector icons per chip, by name or by slot:

```html
<lr-suggestion-chips id="starters">
  <svg slot="icon-chart" viewBox="0 0 8 8"><circle cx="4" cy="4" r="4"></circle></svg>
</lr-suggestion-chips>
<script type="module">
  document.querySelector("#starters").suggestions = [
    { suggestionId: "search", label: "Search the docs", iconName: "search" },
    { suggestionId: "chart", label: "Chart last week" },
  ];
</script>
```
